Subject: Coordination: Tech Deep Dive + Security Intake (scheduling and attendee list)

Hi Alice / Ben —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great to hear more about your latency targets and platform isolation requirements. Per our call I wanted to summarize next steps and propose specific times for the technical deep dive and a short intake with your security and procurement teams.

Quick recap (from my notes):
- Primary use case: interactive customer support assistants serving English + Spanish, peak concurrent sessions ~150.
- SLO: 95th percentile < 300ms for short responses (<= 128 tokens).
- Data residency: US; possible private deployment consideration.
- Items you flagged: SOC 2 evidence, SLA terms, procurement T&Cs.

Proposed next meetings:
1) Technical deep dive (60 min) — attendees: product engineering + infra + our runtime leads (will cover batching, quantization options, and KV-cache sizing).
2) Security intake (30 min) — attendees: your security contacts + Redwood security/ops to run through questionnaire and evidence mapping.

Proposed time windows (all in ET):
- Tue Feb 16: 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed Feb 17: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00

Marissa (cc), Monica (cc) — can you confirm availability for the tech deep dive and whether Monica should lead the security intake? I attached a short prep deck and the intake spreadsheet to kick off the evidence mapping.

If those slots work for you Alice/Ben, I’ll lock them and send calendar invites. If not, please propose three windows that fit your team.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Calendly: https://calendly.example/priyom

- Slateworks_Security-Intake.xlsx (spreadsheet, intake template)

Thanks Priyom — solid recap.

We can do the tech deep dive on Tue Feb 16 at 11:00 ET. I’ve looped in Ben (engineering lead) and procurement. For the security intake, our security lead (Samir Patel) is out Tue afternoon; would Wed Feb 17 at 14:00 ET work for a 30-min intake?

Two quick asks before the deep dive if possible:
- Can you share a short mapping of which artifacts you typically provide for SOC 2 (e.g., network diagrams, access control docs)?
- Any rough order-of-magnitude cost figure for a Dedicated deployment supporting ~150 concurrent sessions? A ballpark is fine.

I’ll wait on the calendar invite. Looking forward to meeting Marissa and Monica.

Best,
Alice
Head of Product | Slateworks
